waves.goal: One unambiguous release truth, exact local runtime/build/browser proof and a frozen local release candidate.
Prove cross-surface consistency and measurable incremental value for Basic, Pro and Advanced on shared real-case denominators.
A frozen, cross-domain adversarial campaign with zero unresolved Critical/High findings.
Execute the existing A47-A57 program on one frozen source and disposable staging without skipping a failed stage.
Obtain signed rights, legal classification, independent assurance, customer value and per-SKU release decisions.

legalAndRegulatoryPerimeter.scope: Accounts, analytics, cookies, security logs, wallet/entity labels, support, exports, deletion and cross-border processors.
Brain, Angel, risk analysis, generated reports, AI interaction disclosure, model/tool roles and human oversight.
Token plans, crypto information, market/risk outputs, alerts, recommendations, execution links and community content.
Any custody, transfer, exchange, token sale, wallet payments or regulated crypto service.
Square/community posts, comments, moderation, recommendations, advertising and minors.
E-commerce, account, checkout, customer support, PDFs and mobile/desktop service flows.
Paid digital tiers, subscriptions, one-off reports, refunds, planned prices and digital service conformity.
Checkout, test/live payments, refunds, reconciliation, payment data and BLIK/SCA.
Market, chain, labels, order books, securities, PDFs, caching, derived metrics, AI/RAG and redistribution.
Services supplied to regulated financial entities or operation as a regulated crypto/financial entity.
Entity/sector/size classification and any software product with digital elements made available on the market.
Cloud/data processing switching, customer export, interoperability and unfair contractual terms where applicable.
EU B2C/B2B digital services, Germany/Poland establishment, token and payment flows.
Source, dependencies, fonts/assets, market data, training/RAG inputs, AI output, trademarks and customer report rights.
Account eligibility, community, financial content, profiling, marketing and support.
Audit, risk, market analysis, data errors, cyber incident, outage, customer loss and contractual caps.

globalStopConditions: Any unresolved Critical or High security finding
Any missing required provider right for a delivered field
Any missing signed legal applicability decision for an enabled territory or feature
Any failed tenant isolation, refund, rollback, incident recovery or entitlement check
Any stale, partial, conflicted or fixture evidence presented as LIVE
Any paid tier without measured incremental customer value and an exact SKU decision
truthBoundary: A81 locally unifies the frozen synthetic corpus and adapter outputs into one canonical Basic/Pro/Advanced mega-matrix with exact cross-channel claim parity and tier monotonicity. A80 is not a verified release candidate and no real provider, browser, physical PDF, model, customer, staging, LIVE or sale credit is granted. A82 adds a local real-contract intake and fixture harness only; it does not add real audit accuracy or paid readiness.

discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Supply exact runtime, 827 lock-bound tarballs and exact Chromium, then rerun all 30 suites without shims.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: A62 inherited the parent process environment and system PATH and rewrote the extracted npm wrapper, weakening exact-runtime and secret-isolation claims.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Execute with physical exact bundles and prove runtime tree digest unchanged before/after.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No exact credit until physical execution.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: The current-root gate compared every descendant source tree directly with the frozen A77 genesis payload, making legal future passes look like genesis tampering.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Preserve A77 genesis immutably and verify each descendant through the A78 parent-bound current-root manifest.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; lineage correctness only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: Only 81/827 lock paths are covered by exact local CAS bytes; exact Node 24.18.0/npm 11.16.0 and platform-exact Playwright 1.60.0 Chromium are not supplied.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Supply the three external bundles, verify all hashes/SRI, run isolated offline npm ci, current-root 30/30 and A60.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: A78 remains partial and A79 remains blocked.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: A60 allowed an environment-controlled browser base URL, so acceptance could target a non-local or unrelated server.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Use only a runner-selected dynamic 127.0.0.1 port and reject all base URL overrides.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: A60 invoked system npm and enabled shell execution on Windows instead of exact runtime-owned node/npm-cli paths.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Execute every stage through exact process.execPath + runtime-owned npm-cli with shell=false.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: A60 verified declared manifest rows but did not reject additional active source files outside the declared path set.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Recompute the active inventory denominator and require exact path-set parity before and after execution.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: Existing A45 receipts and screenshots were not removed before a new run, allowing stale artifacts to survive a partial execution.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Delete the A45 artifact root after preflight and before any exact stages.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: The browser evidence verifier checked counts and presence but not the exact unique locale-route-viewport matrix.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Require exactly 27 desktop plus 9 PL mobile unique rows and reject duplicates or omissions.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: Browser evidence was not bound to the exact source manifest, runtime instance, browser executable and final Next build ID.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Bind all four identities into the browser receipt and verifier.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: The popup screenshot was counted but had no declared digest in the browser receipt.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Record and verify the popup screenshot SHA-256 exactly.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: Screenshot verification checked file hashes only when declared and did not validate PNG structure or dimensions.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Require all 19 declared hashes plus bounded PNG IHDR/IDAT/IEND structure and dimensions.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: A fixed port and weak server ownership check could confuse a pre-existing local server with the spawned production runtime.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Reserve a dynamic loopback port, reject overrides, and fail if the spawned process exits before readiness.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: First-party request failures were recorded but did not fail an otherwise green route.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Make every first-party request failure a route failure while retaining bounded diagnostics.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: Package metadata still pointed to the A77 patch/program while the current source was A78.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Bind package metadata, active pass, current authority and program path to A79 in one update.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: The deterministic release packager could produce an integral ZIP without proving that exact A78/A79 execution was VERIFIED, allowing package integrity to be confused with release-candidate readiness.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Require verified exact toolchain, exact build/browser, current-root 30/30 and clean-unpack integrity before candidate issuance.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; exact execution remains blocked.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: Release-candidate receipts could be written inside the source tree, mutating the supposedly frozen candidate after validation.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Require all candidate receipts and seals to be written outside the source root and verify source bytes remain unchanged.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local freeze boundary only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: No dedicated candidate hygiene gate rejected private/live evidence, .env files, keys, databases, logs, caches, node_modules or .next from a candidate source tree.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Run a fail-closed source hygiene inventory before issuing any candidate seal.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; local admission hardening only.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: A stale or fixture A60 receipt could be treated as build evidence unless exact decision, runtime, stages, bindings and source parity were revalidated together.
discoveredGapLedger.followUp: Revalidate the complete exact A60 receipt and all source/runtime/browser/build bindings inside A80.
discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; exact receipt still unavailable.

discoveredGapLedger.summary: A release candidate could be promoted while LIVE or sale flags were true even though no staging/customer/provider/legal gates had passed.

discoveredGapLedger.percentageEffect: No canonical credit; lineage and supersession correctness only.
